alerts.lostStepsBody: Each time it was put back on its position. Pieces since the check before may be in the wrong bins.

footer.hint: Pause the machine to check now.

stressTest.description: Bounce the chute back and forth at speed to exercise the mechanics and the stepper.

runs.title: Stress test runs
runs.description: What each run did, and what the driver read while it ran.

telemetry.noTelemetryRecorded: No driver telemetry recorded for this run yet.
telemetry.driverSettingsHeading: Driver settings, read from the hardware as the run started
telemetry.scaleNote: Each series is scaled to its own range; the ranges below are absolute.

microstepping.label: Microstepping
microstepping.lockedHelp: Locked: the chute’s bin-aiming math is calibrated for this value.

stepperEndstopSettings.help: Flip it if the endstop reads backwards.

stepperPulseControls.degreesAriaLabel: Degrees at the output for each press
stepperPulseControls.arrowKeysHint: The arrow keys jog it too.
stepperPulseControls.gearRatioNote: Gear ratio {ratio}:1, so {outputDeg}° at the output is {motorDeg}° at the motor.

errors.readFailed: Failed to read the automatic tuning
errors.changeFailed: Failed to change the automatic tuning

panel.title: Automatic tuning
panel.description: Sets the trigger from how {label} runs.

tuneAutomatically.label: Tune automatically
tuneAutomatically.help: A threshold saved by hand turns it off.

alerts.notRunning: Not running: StallGuard is off on this machine.
alerts.workingHarderBody: Normal running read {baseline} or higher; now {normal}. Check {label} turns freely, then learn again.
alerts.closeToStallTitle: Normal running is close to a stall
alerts.closeToStallBody: It reads {normal} or higher. A stall still trips it, with little room.

panel.title: Load curve
panel.description: SG_RESULT over time. Lower means more load; a stall drops it toward 0.

suggestion.heading: Threshold suggestion for {label}
suggestion.explanation: SGTHRS is the geometric midpoint of the gap between the measured floor and dip. TCOOLTHRS is the measured cruise TSTEP (the fastest sustained) times 1.75, so the gate stays open through cruise and off while speeding up or slowing down.
suggestion.provisionalNote: There is no stall at this speed to pair it with yet, so these numbers are provisional.

stepperStallGuardSettings.helpBase: Halts the machine if this motor stalls, on every move while it's on.
stepperStallGuardSettings.helpTuneSuffix: Tune the threshold on the StallGuard tab.
stepperStallGuardSettings.setByAutoWithHref: Set by automatic tuning, on the StallGuard tab.
stepperStallGuardSettings.tripNote: Trips when SG_RESULT is {thrs} or less, only at cruising speed (TSTEP up to {tcoolthrs}).
stepperStallGuardSettings.cantTripTitle: StallGuard can't trip at this speed
stepperStallGuardSettings.cantTripBody: At {speed} µsteps/s and 1/{microsteps} microstepping this motor cruises at TSTEP {cruiseTstep}, slower than the speed floor of {floor}, so the driver never checks for a stall.
stepperStallGuardSettings.needsSpeedNote: It needs an operating speed of at least {min} µsteps/s, and then a threshold tuned at that speed.

stepperStallGuardSweepOptions.cruiseHelp: Only motion at or under this TSTEP (lower is faster) counts toward a recording's own readings, since speeding up, slowing down and reversing dip them even unloaded. Empty follows the speed: {autoCruise}. The speed floor saved in step 4 is measured from the recordings, not taken from here.

field.label: Label
field.labelHelp: Optional. Names the recordings in the list.

stepperStallGuardSweepOptions.randomNote: Random go-to-angle between the min and max output angle (clamped to the chute's safe travel, 345° at most), turning straight back on each arrival. Homes the chute first if needed, so it moves on absolute angles and can never reach an endstop.
stepperStallGuardSweepOptions.pulsedNote: Separate pulses with a dwell between them, as the rotors and carousel really run, and an unstick jitter every few pulses. Only the moving phases are sampled.
stepperStallGuardSweepOptions.checkboxEnterToRun: Enter starts the recording of the step that is open
